note: Shop names for L3 fascia signs (slice E5). Picked by jitter(building.id) so a shop keeps its name for its whole life without the name ever entering game state. Deliberately generic: a sign at eye height has to read as a high street, not as a joke you notice twice. One list per locale, the same length in each, so a shop keeps its index across a language change (slice R2).
note_streets: Street names for L3 name signs at junctions (slice S3). Picked by jitter(corridor.id) so a street keeps its name while its corridor does; never game state. Equal length in every locale, like the shops: a language change renames a street and moves none.
